steps.name: One of Three (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Lars] in 「Nidaros」, then enter 「Hyle」 and defeat [Michaela]. Be sure to leave through the reward room, then turn in the quest to [Uriella] in front of 「Tower of Proof」.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: You're so lucky, Pipi. You can fly...
(The sparrow perched on the boy's head chirps as though it understands him. Then it flutters toward someone.)

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Pipi. Where are you going? Pipi!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pipi? Oh, so this Sylphin's name is Pipi.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: What's a Sylphin?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's what these birds are called. They were spirits long ago, but over time they became birds like this.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Wow, Pipi. You used to be a spirit. But... who are you...?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Oh, I've heard your name. I heard rumors that you defeated villains on another continent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's true, but I didn't do it alone. A lot of people helped.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: That's amazing. Why would someone so impressive come to see me...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Embla asked me to help you, Lars. She said something seemed to be troubling you.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: How did she know? I haven't told anyone... All right, I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I want to meet an angel. Then I'll wish to become an adult.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I heard that if you meet an angel, your wish comes true. I want to grow up quickly. Adults can do anything.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: For Dokkalfr elves, unless you have magical or divine power, there aren't many chances to learn things. You have to rely on books.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Apart from special cases like Embla and Askren, who travel outside, most people in Nidaros never leave the village. They just spend their lives doing village work.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I'm not saying that's bad... But the adults tell me to just keep living like this. Honestly, it feels suffocating.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I don't have any friends my age to talk to about it, or adults who'll really listen, so I just... want to grow up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adults can't do everything, and angels don't grant every wish. There isn't a special shortcut to growing up, either...

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: But Grandpa Gregory said he met an angel and had his wish granted. The waves calmed down, and he caught lots of fish.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That can happen when someone prays earnestly. But listen carefully, Lars.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't ask an angel to meet you... But I can ask one to bless you.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really. I'm not lying. But promise me one thing. Don't make a wish like wanting to become an adult...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you make the wrong wish, a devil comes instead.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I-I promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm short on time, but I should be able to make a quick trip.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good. Then wait here.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: All right, %s.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Is it really true? That %s will ask an angel to bless me...?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Oh, hello, Grandpa Gregory.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: Hello there. What were you talking about with that person?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: %s says they know an angel. So...

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: An angel...?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is so happy you came, %s. What brings you here today...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain to Michaela why you came from Nidaros, and tell her about the boy Lars.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika understands. I'll bless that boy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So we'll be sparring again, Michaela...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: We'll spar too, but take what Mika gives you to Ur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ur... Wait, huh?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, come here. Mika wants to greet you.
(Michaela approaches %s and gently kisses your cheek.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! Uriella, who was outside the Tower of Trial! The one who said she'd changed how she talked...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: There, done.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika isn't sure, but it seems you had forgotten Ur. Now you should be able to remember her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why couldn't I remember Uriella?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika doesn't really know, but it seems there were versions of you in different timelines. Some of you seem to have met Ur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...That's...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: It isn't your fault.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I can't linger. I'm short on time, so I need to hurry...

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: All right. Mika will wait for you at the far end of Hyle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Sparring's over. Thank you, %s. Mika feels much better now.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: This is Mika's feather. Give it to Ur.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I'm the one who should thank you.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Come visit again later. Mika will be waiting.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, eat these on your way.
(Mika brings a plain box and hands it to %s. Opening the lid releases the sweet aroma of cookies.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: (Munch, munch.) These are delicious. Aurum brought them. Someone called Jelic made them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So Jelic made these.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: One portion is for you, %s. Eat it on your way. Another is for Ur, and the last is for Rapi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for the food, Michaela. I'll come back with news of the other angels.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you. Goodbye.

steps.name: One of Three (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Uriella] in front of 「Tower of Proof」, then enter 「Aegir Ruins」 and defeat [Raphaella]. Be sure to leave through the reward room, then turn in the quest to [Uriella] in front of 「Tower of Proof」.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Oh, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Uriella.
(Uriella approaches quietly and gently kisses your cheek.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Look how startled you are. Hehe. Anyway, I'm relieved.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I was worried you'd forgotten me, but you remembered and came back. Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How could I forget you angrily saying, 'Ur says...'?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Forget that! I said forget it, you fool!
(As Uriella loses her temper, the tower behind her shakes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. Please calm down. The reason I came today is... this...

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Oh my, what's this?! It's Mika's feather. Give it here! Hurry!
(As soon as Uriella receives the feather in both hands, she clutches it to her chest. A warm light comes drifting on the breeze from somewhere and brushes past her.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Mika... You've been waiting for us for so long...

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Ur will wait for Mika, Rapi, and Gab. The goddess said we'll be able to meet soon.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Oh, I mean I! I! I!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uriella, this is a gift from Michaela.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Oh, something to eat? Wow, how is this so delicious? Does Mika always eat things like this? I'm jealous.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: (Munch, munch.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: %s, aren't you short on time? You promised to get an angel's blessing for an elf boy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I haven't told you yet. How did you know?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I could sense a little through Mika's feather. I can't do it right now, but if you go see Rapi, I think I'll be able to help properly afterward.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. Raphaella.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: It would be perfect if you could see Gab too, but no one knows where she is. It's all right. Seeing Rapi will be enough.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I'll give him a true blessing, with all my heart. Blessings are Uriella's specialty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By Gab, you mean Gabriella, right?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Yes. Somehow, I feel we'll be able to see her soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I really hope so.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Hehe, wouldn't that be wonderful? (Munch, munch.) Hehe. Oh, get a feather from Rapi too, just as you did from Mika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, Uriella.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Oh, I've eaten them all... I should have asked %s for one more before they left.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Sniff, sniff. Something smells delicious. Oh! %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Raphaella.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: I missed you! Welcome!
(Raphaella rushes at %s with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaah! You startled me!

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Sorry. Rapi was so bored. It's been ages since I saw a face other than Hefring's.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rolling around with Hefring! Hefring said I'd lose weight living like this and brought mountains of packed lunches.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: So I've been thanking Leon and blessing him every time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did Hefring steal Leon's lunches...?)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Now, let Rapi greet you. Huh?!
(Raphaella pauses just before kissing %s on the cheek.)

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: %s, did you come after seeing Mika and Ur? Is Ur back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Uriella appeared a few days ago, and I met her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And I think Uriella used Michaela's feather to read her memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why I need one of your feathers too.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Good, good! Take one after we spar. You can pluck them all if you like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, sparring...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be quick, right?

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Yes. Rapi doesn't like taking too long either, so let's finish quickly. I'll wait at the far end of the ruins.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is choosing not to spar an option?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, she's gone... It can't be helped. I'd better head to the end of the ruins. I know the way by heart now, so it should be fine. Phew...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Wahaha! Sparring is so much fun. I've had my fill, so we're done. Go ahead and take as many feathers as you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Raphaella. One feather will be enough, though.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. What I left over there is a gift Michaela asked me to bring.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Oh, that smell! Food! Ooh, cookies.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: (Munch, munch.) Wow, they're so good. Is it because they're a gift from Mika? They taste even better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know the elf who made these cookies. He makes lots of other delicious food too.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rapi wants to try it too. Sob.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please don't cry. Someday, you'll be able to eat lots of delicious things with Michaela, Uriella, and Gabriella.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rapi believes that will happen too. By the way, have you met Gab?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet. I don't know where she is, so I haven't met her, but I'll bring you news right away if I do.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Rapi is so happy to finally know how Mika and Ur are doing.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: Sob...

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: (Munch, munch.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Raphaella. Please have the rest of mine too. I've eaten plenty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm short on time, so I need to go. But next time, I'll make sure I have plenty of time to visit you.

lines.speaker: 라파엘라
lines.text: All right. Thank you, %s. Take care.

steps.name: One of Three (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Uriella] in front of 「Tower of Proof」, then talk to [Lars] in 「Nidaros」 and turn in the quest to [Lars].

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Oh, you're back already.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm short on time. Uriella, I brought Raphaella's feather.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: You came back faster than I expected. It's all right if you're a little late. Time will flow a little differently while you're helping us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pardon?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Mika placed a small blessing on you. I wanted to help too, so I added the same blessing.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: That silly Rapi noticed you had an angel's blessing and did the same.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: We really are sisters. We think alike in things like that.
(Uriella cups Raphaella's feather in both hands. A brighter light than before rides the breeze, circles around her, and soon disappears.)

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Rapi has been through so much too...

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Phew. I need to be stronger as well. I'll prepare my heart so we can all meet again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You definitely will.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Now, I'd like to bless that boy too. What would be best?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Something suited to a child his age, of course. %s, tell him to choose one of these three.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: The first blessing will have a spirit of knowledge help him study, giving him insight into things he didn't understand.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: The second will have a spirit of food improve his appetite, so he can enjoy any food while he's growing.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: The third blessing will let a spirit of emotion stay with him, helping him treasure what matters to him and express his feelings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will the blessing reach Lars as soon as he chooses?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: I can't go in person, so the blessing will come through the Sylphin he rescued. Lady Iris has given her permission too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, by Sylphin, you mean the sparrow on Lars's head?

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: That's right. A strong wind swept it into a wall, and that boy saved it. He treated its injured leg too. Most people would simply have walked past... That's more than enough to deserve a blessing.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Even if we didn't bless him, someone else would have. I'm glad he's a kind child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me too. Well, Uriella, I'd better go.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Wait. You have to receive my greeting before you leave.

lines.speaker: 우리엘라
lines.text: Goodbye. See you next time. Don't forget to bring armfuls of cookies.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's all my fault.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? What is?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Wanting to wish myself into an adult, and simply wanting a blessing. All of it...

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Results need a process behind them. I didn't understand that, and I tried to get everything at once without putting in the work...

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Even your trip to meet the angels must have been difficult, %s.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Saving Pipi was just a coincidence. I didn't do it because I wanted a blessing...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The angel praised you, Lars. She said even if an angel didn't bless you, someone would have rewarded you.
(At that moment, the Sylphin on Lars's head takes flight and pecks at his forehead.)

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Ow! Pipi, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pipi says to stop being silly and make your choice.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Then I'll accept it gratefully. The first... I'm already doing well studying on my own, so I don't need that.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: The second might make me as greedy for food as Carmen, so I'm not sure about that.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: To treasure what's important and express my feelings better... Maybe that's what I need right now.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Thank you, Pipi.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Somehow, I feel warm inside. I suppose that means it all worked out...)

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Um, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Did I really receive a blessing? I feel just the same as usual...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, who knows?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: You've gone through so much trouble for me. I'll go see Carmen now.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I said some really nasty things to her last time. I didn't even mean them.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I said even Hefring, who eats an incredible amount, doesn't eat like she does...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Ah, that was a bit harsh.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: I should go apologize. She's my only sister...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. See you later.

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Goodbye. So you're staying at that inn over there...

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: Grandpa Gregory! Have you been fishing?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I have. Lars, by any chance... did you meet an angel?

lines.speaker: 라스
lines.text: No, I didn't. I did receive something like a blessing, though... Huh? How did you know?

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: I've felt the energy around you once before.

lines.speaker: 그레고리
lines.text: When I was young, I too received an angel's blessing, quite by chance...
